evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; growth requires pressure verification, so required atmosphere telemetry is unavailable.
Exhaust oxygen increased to 9.8 ppm at growth onset from 2.4 ppm at the end of the ramp.
Exhaust oxygen continued rising to 17.1 ppm.
Exhaust oxygen reached 25.6 ppm; this sustained rise is concerning but does not identify a fault or establish tube pressure.
Temperature 749.8 °C and argon 99.8 sccm track their setpoints; tube pressure remains unavailable.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning tube pressure gauge and growth-stage pressure/O2 acceptance limits are needed to verify atmosphere conditions; investigate the rising O2 with independent oxygen and leak/exhaust checks. Sample characterization is not yet available.
